author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@cathieleblanc Cathie when I said @withknown I mean Known-like same thinng with OmniBear. I was using tools I use to draw up my mental model of what I want my future to look like.

@chrisaldrich is right. While @withknown helped to bring #indieweb to a larger audience it is now maintained by a few where as WordPress is maintained by the many.

What I drew up wasn't an endorsement of any platform. It was just me trying to learn how all this stuff works using your idea of drawing mental maps.
